topic: Day 2 — carousel — The life you want is built in ordinary Tuesdays, not big moments

slides.text: Boring days make the actual change.
Nobody's life flipped in one dramatic afternoon.
It flipped from a thousand unremarkable ones, stacked the same direction.
Repetition compounds. Intensity just feels like it should.
The [boring] days are the ones that stack.

caption:
Nobody's life changed in one dramatic moment. It changed in a thousand ordinary days stacked in the same direction.

Follow for one of these a day.
